method: A_i = DTI_i*(0.2*n_i + 0.8*G) under B_i ~= n_i - A_i
caveats: B_i ~= n_i - A_i assumes a 1-px-thick binary support, which every group submission is (is_binary_0_1 = true in the registry).

|G| is not identified by a single file; the grid search picks the value for which implied efficiencies are plausible and show diminishing returns with budget. Treat it as an order-of-magnitude estimate with a stated sensitivity, not a measurement.
Scores are owner-reported public numbers, cross-checked against the live leaderboard on 2026-10-01, not authenticated receipts.

recommended_budget.policy: median of the per-fold live-rescaled optima under the pessimistic coverage_penalty = 0.5 (new faults are assumed half as findable as held-out catalogue faults)
